about: Declared slates: the N a counter's trials are judged at, when the team lead fixed one, for scripts/research/registry.py (minimum_declared_n, paper_sr0, bars). Proposed 2026-10-28 on branch research-loop-gate. The team lead approves it by merging that branch, and only the team lead adds or changes a row. Each row copies a ruling already recorded at its source; the table makes none. A standing slate sets the least N a new trial on that counter may declare. A closed slate takes no new trial: `closed_at` is the number of trials it held when it closed (a slate can close below its N), and one more trial on that counter needs a new declaration, which is the team lead's ruling. A counter with no row is a running count, whose least N is the counter itself.
